<action type="say">
Here’s a step‑by‑step for united.com to hunt this down.

1) Get your MileagePlus number back  
1. Go to https://www.united.com  
2. Top right: click “Sign in”.  
3. Under the sign‑in form, click “Forgot MileagePlus number?”.  
4. On that page:  
   - Choose to look it up by “Email address and last name”.  
   - Enter:  
     • Email (e.g., marcus.trebek@example.com or maya.thompson@example.com)  
     • Last name: Thompson  
   - Submit and follow the prompts. United will either show you the number or email it to you.

2) Sign in to your account  
1. Back on the main sign‑in screen, enter:  
   - Your MileagePlus number (or username),  
   - Password.  
   (If you don’t remember the password, use “Forgot password?” and reset.)

3) Go to your trips and look for Oct 16–18  
1. Once signed in, look at the top navigation bar.  
2. Hover over or click “My trips” (sometimes just “Trips”).  
3. Choose “Upcoming trips” (or just “Trips” if that’s the only option).  
4. On the trips page:  
   - Look for any itinerary around Oct 16–18.  
   - Click each candidate to see the details (origin/destination).  
   - You’re looking for something like SFO/OAK → DCA/IAD (or return).

If you don’t see anything there, try:

4) Search for a trip without logging in  
1. At the top of united.com, hover over “My trips”.  
2. Click “Find a trip” (or “Manage trips”).  
3. You’ll see a form like “Find your trip”:  
   - Try “Confirmation number” if you have it anywhere; otherwise:  
   - Switch to the option that says something like “Credit card number” or “MileagePlus number”.  
4. Use:  
   - Last name: Thompson  
   - Credit/debit card: full number you used to buy the ticket (this just locates the trip; it doesn’t charge anything).  

They’ll show matching reservations; open anything around Oct 16–18 and check if it’s your Oakland/SFO ↔ DC trip.

If you tell me whether you’re on a laptop or phone and what you see at the top of the United page (“Sign in”, “My trips”, etc.), I can tailor the next clicks exactly to your screen. </action>
